---
id: env.cover.contractors-pollution-liability
type: cover
heading: Contractors Pollution Liability
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

We will pay loss that you become legally liable to pay because of personal injury, property damage, natural resource damage or clean-up costs resulting from a pollution condition that:

- is caused by covered operations;
- began on or after the retroactive date; and
- results in a claim first made against you during the policy period and notified to us during the policy period or any extended reporting period, as [[ref:env.cover.claims-made-and-notified]] sets out.
